proposal.hypothesis: Density is called repeatedly during raymarching and transmittance. Replacing its eight D calls with six shared clamps and reusable flat row/plane offsets may reduce redundant integer/address work without a copied or precomputed volume. Coordinate conversion, inclusive Inside test, per-neighbor clamping, and interpolation order remain unchanged; the compiler may already eliminate some redundancy, so only isolated controller measurements can establish benefit.

retained: Remplacer les huit appels D dans Density par le clamp explicite des deux indices voisins par axe, puis réutiliser les offsets plats de lignes et de plans pour les huit lectures.
